name: Exp_ColorMaRsi-Trigger_MMRec_Duplex
summary: This EA trades both long and short directions using a colored Moving Average trend filter combined with RSI momentum triggers for entry signals. It incorporates a Money Management Recommendation (MMRec) system for dynamic position sizing and risk control. The Duplex designation means it can simultaneously manage buy and sell positions based on opposing signal conditions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用彩色均线趋势过滤结合RSI动量触发器作为入场信号，同时支持多空双向交易。它集成了资金管理推荐(MMRec)系统用于动态仓位管理和风险控制。Duplex标识意味着它可以基于相反信号条件同时管理买入和卖出仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是结合彩色均线和RSI指标的复合趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：彩色均线显示上升趋势且RSI从超卖区上穿触发线时做多，彩色均线显示下降趋势且RSI从超买区下穿触发线时做空。出场条件包括：反向信号出现时平仓、止损/止盈触发、以及均线颜色反转时趋势结束退出。仓位管理采用MMRec资金管理推荐系统，根据账户余额和风险参数动态计算交易手数，避免固定手数的风险暴露不均问题。资金管理方面，系统通过Duplex双工模式允许同时持有多空仓位，这在震荡趋势转换期间可能提供对冲保护，但也增加了保证金占用和复杂度。整体策略属于典型的多指标确认趋势跟踪方法，通过双重过滤减少假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a composite trend-following system combining a colored Moving Average with RSI indicator. Entry conditions: go long when the colored MA shows an uptrend and RSI crosses above the trigger line from oversold territory; go short when the colored MA shows a downtrend and RSI crosses below the trigger line from overbought territory. Exit conditions include: closing positions on reverse signals, stop-loss/take-profit triggers, and trend-end exits when the MA color reverses. Position sizing employs the MMRec money management recommendation system, dynamically calculating lot sizes based on account balance and risk parameters, avoiding uneven risk exposure from fixed lot sizes. In terms of money management, the Duplex mode allows holding both long and short positions simultaneously, which may provide hedging protection during trend transitions but also increases margin usage and complexity. The overall strategy is a typical multi-indicator-confirmed trend-following approach that reduces false signals through dual filtering.

parameters.name: MMRec_Enable
parameters.description: 启用资金管理推荐系统

parameters.name: Duplex_Mode
parameters.description: 启用双工模式(同时多空)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单

pros: 双指标确认机制（均线+RSI）有效减少假信号和错误入场
MMRec资金管理推荐系统根据账户动态调整仓位，风险控制更科学
Duplex双工模式在趋势转换期提供对冲保护，降低单边风险敞口
彩色均线直观显示趋势方向，便于可视化验证和调试
支持同时多空操作，适应震荡趋势转换的市场环境
pros_en: Dual indicator confirmation (MA+RSI) effectively reduces false signals and incorrect entries
MMRec money management recommendation system dynamically adjusts position size based on account, providing more scientific risk control
Duplex mode provides hedging protection during trend transitions, reducing directional risk exposure
Colored MA visually displays trend direction, facilitating visual verification and debugging
Supports simultaneous long-short operations, adapting to market environments with oscillating trend transitions
cons: Duplex双工模式同时持有多空仓位会占用更多保证金，降低资金利用效率
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假突破信号导致连续亏损
依赖止损和止盈参数设置，默认值为0表示禁用，新手使用可能面临无限亏损风险
彩色均线的颜色转换逻辑在快速波动市场中可能存在延迟
RSI在强趋势市场中可能长期处于超买/超卖区，导致错过趋势延续行情
cons_en: Duplex mode holding both long and short positions simultaneously consumes more margin, reducing capital efficiency
Trend-following strategies tend to generate frequent false breakout signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Depends on stop-loss and take-profit parameter settings; default value of 0 means disabled, posing unlimited loss risk for beginners
The colored MA's color transition logic may have lag in fast-moving markets
RSI can remain in overbought/oversold territory for extended periods during strong trends, causing missed trend continuation opportunities
improvements: 增加时间过滤和波动率过滤（如ATR），避免在低流动性时段和极端波动时段交易
为止损和止盈设置合理的非零默认值，并加入强制止损检查以保护资金安全
增加新K线检查机制防止同一K线内重复开仓，并加入点差过滤避免高滑点入场
improvements_en: Add time filter and volatility filter (e.g., ATR) to avoid trading during low liquidity sessions and extreme volatility periods
Set reasonable non-zero default values for stop-loss and take-profit, and add mandatory stop-loss checks to protect capital safety
Add new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated opening within the same bar, and include spread filter to avoid high slippage entries

risk_points: 止损止盈默认值为0，如果不手动设置则面临无限亏损风险
Duplex双工模式同时持有多空仓位增加保证金占用，极端行情下可能面临强制平仓
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生连续小幅亏损，缺乏震荡市识别和自动禁用机制
risk_points_en: Stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, posing unlimited loss risk if not manually configured
Duplex mode holding both long and short positions increases margin usage, risking forced liquidation during extreme market conditions
Trend-following strategy tends to produce consecutive small losses in ranging markets, lacking range detection and auto-disable mechanism

It incorporates a Money Management Recommendation (MMRec) system for dynamic position sizing and risk control. The Duplex designation means it can simultaneously manage buy and sell positions based on opposing signal conditions.
